example: I’ll arrange a meeting with the client so we can discuss the revised proposal.

fr.definition: Préparer les détails d’une réunion, d’un rendez-vous ou d’une activité.

de.definition: Die Einzelheiten eines Treffens oder einer Aktivität planen.

es.definition: Preparar los detalles de una reunión o una actividad.

pt.definition: Planear os detalhes de uma reunião ou atividade.

definition: To go to a meeting or event and be there.
example: Everyone who attends the planning meeting should bring one idea for the new campaign.

fr.definition: Être présent à une réunion ou à un événement.

de.definition: Bei einer Besprechung oder Veranstaltung dabei sein.

es.definition: Estar presente en una reunión o un acto.

pt.definition: Estar presente numa reunião ou num evento.

definition: To decide that a planned event or arrangement will not happen.
example: We had to cancel Friday's review because the supplier could not send the figures.

fr.definition: Décider qu’un événement ou un rendez-vous prévu n’aura pas lieu.

de.definition: Entscheiden, dass eine geplante Veranstaltung oder ein Termin nicht stattfindet.

es.definition: Decidir que un acto o una cita prevista no tendrá lugar.

pt.definition: Decidir que um evento ou compromisso previsto não vai acontecer.

definition: A choice made after thinking about what to do.
example: The team made a decision to delay the launch until testing was complete.

fr.definition: Un choix fait après avoir réfléchi à ce qu’il faut faire.

de.definition: Eine Wahl, die nach dem Nachdenken darüber getroffen wird, was zu tun ist.

es.definition: Una elección hecha después de pensar qué hacer.

pt.definition: Uma escolha feita depois de pensar no que fazer.

definition: A file sent with an email.
example: I included the revised budget as an attachment to my email.

fr.definition: Un fichier envoyé avec un courriel.

de.definition: Eine Datei, die mit einer E-Mail gesendet wird.

es.definition: Un archivo enviado con un correo electrónico.

pt.definition: Um ficheiro enviado com uma mensagem de correio eletrónico.

definition: To send a message or file you received to someone else.
example: Could you forward the supplier's message to everyone on the project team?

fr.definition: Envoyer à quelqu’un un message ou un fichier reçu.

de.definition: Eine erhaltene Nachricht oder Datei an jemand anderen senden.

es.definition: Enviar a otra persona un mensaje o archivo recibido.

pt.definition: Enviar a outra pessoa uma mensagem ou ficheiro recebido.

definition: A piece of work that needs to be done.
example: Her first task is to prepare a short summary of the customer feedback.

fr.definition: Un travail qu’il faut accomplir.

de.definition: Eine Arbeit, die erledigt werden muss.

es.definition: Un trabajo que hay que hacer.

pt.definition: Um trabalho que é preciso fazer.

definition: The latest time or date by which something must be finished.
example: We need the final figures by Tuesday to meet the reporting deadline.

fr.definition: Le dernier jour ou moment pour terminer quelque chose.

de.definition: Der letzte Zeitpunkt, bis zu dem etwas fertig sein muss.

es.definition: El último día o momento para terminar algo.

pt.definition: O último dia ou momento para terminar alguma coisa.

definition: A person whose job is to lead a team or control part of a business.
example: The manager approved my request to work from home on Thursday.

fr.definition: Une personne chargée de diriger une équipe ou une activité.

de.definition: Eine Person, die ein Team oder einen Geschäftsbereich leitet.

es.definition: Una persona que dirige un equipo o una parte de una empresa.

pt.definition: Uma pessoa que dirige uma equipa ou uma área de uma empresa.

definition: A document that lists your education, skills, and work history.
example: Please send your CV before the interview so the panel can review your experience.

fr.definition: Un document qui présente les études, les compétences et l’expérience professionnelle d’une personne.

de.definition: Ein Dokument mit Ausbildung, Fähigkeiten und bisheriger Berufserfahrung.

es.definition: Un documento con los estudios, las habilidades y la experiencia laboral de una persona.

pt.definition: Um documento com a formação, as competências e a experiência profissional de uma pessoa.

definition: An event where people come together to talk about work or make plans.
example: Our meeting starts at ten, so please bring the latest sales figures.

fr.definition: Un moment où des personnes se retrouvent pour parler du travail ou faire des projets.

de.definition: Ein Treffen, bei dem Menschen über die Arbeit sprechen oder Pläne machen.

es.definition: Un encuentro para hablar del trabajo o hacer planes.

pt.definition: Um encontro para falar sobre o trabalho ou fazer planos.

definition: A meeting plan showing what people will discuss and in what order.
example: Could you add the budget review to tomorrow’s agenda before sending it to the team?

fr.definition: Plan des sujets à aborder pendant une réunion.

de.definition: Plan der Themen für eine Besprechung.

es.definition: Plan de los asuntos que se tratarán en una reunión.

pt.definition: Plano dos assuntos a tratar numa reunião.

definition: A written record of what people discussed and decided at a meeting.
example: Could you send the minutes to everyone who attended before the end of the day?

fr.definition: Document qui résume les échanges et les décisions d’une réunion.

de.definition: Schriftliche Aufzeichnung der wichtigsten Besprechungspunkte und Beschlüsse.

es.definition: Documento que recoge los temas tratados y los acuerdos de una reunión.

pt.definition: Documento que regista os assuntos tratados e as decisões de uma reunião.

definition: To lead a meeting and make sure it stays organized and on time.
example: Maya will chair a meeting with the regional managers on Thursday.

fr.definition: Diriger une réunion et veiller à son bon déroulement.

de.definition: Eine Sitzung führen und für einen geordneten Ablauf sorgen.

es.definition: Dirigir una reunión y procurar que se desarrolle de forma ordenada.

pt.definition: Dirigir uma reunião e assegurar o seu bom andamento.

definition: To write down the main points and decisions made during a meeting.
example: I can take minutes today, so you can focus on guiding the discussion.

fr.definition: Noter les principaux points et décisions d’une réunion.

de.definition: Die wichtigsten Punkte und Beschlüsse einer Sitzung schriftlich festhalten.

es.definition: Anotar los puntos principales y los acuerdos de una reunión.

pt.definition: Registar por escrito os principais assuntos e decisões de uma reunião.

definition: A suggested plan or idea put forward for others to consider.
example: The team reviewed our proposal and asked for a clearer estimate of the costs.

fr.definition: Idée ou plan soumis à l’examen d’autres personnes.

de.definition: Eine Idee oder ein Plan, über den andere entscheiden sollen.

es.definition: Idea o plan presentado para que otras personas lo valoren.

pt.definition: Ideia ou plano apresentado para outras pessoas analisarem.

definition: An agreement in which each side accepts less than it wanted.
example: We reached a compromise on the delivery date after both teams adjusted their plans.

fr.definition: Accord dans lequel chaque partie accepte de faire des concessions.

de.definition: Einigung, bei der beide Seiten von ihren Forderungen abrücken.

es.definition: Acuerdo en el que cada parte cede en algo.

pt.definition: Acordo em que cada parte aceita ceder em alguma coisa.

definition: Comments that explain what is good or needs improvement in someone's work.
example: Please send me your feedback on the draft before I share it with the client.

fr.definition: Avis sur les points forts et les aspects à améliorer.

de.definition: Rückmeldung dazu, was an einer Arbeit gut ist oder verbessert werden kann.

es.definition: Opiniones sobre lo que está bien o se puede mejorar en un trabajo.

pt.definition: Opinião sobre o que está bem ou pode ser melhorado num trabalho.

definition: To take further action or contact someone again about something.
example: I’ll follow up with the supplier tomorrow if we haven’t received the revised quote.

fr.definition: Reprendre contact ou agir de nouveau au sujet de quelque chose.

de.definition: Noch einmal nachfragen oder weitere Schritte unternehmen.

es.definition: Volver a contactar o actuar para comprobar cómo avanza un asunto.

pt.definition: Voltar a contactar ou tomar outras medidas sobre um assunto.

definition: To reply to someone later, often after checking or thinking.
example: I need to check the figures before I get back to you with a firm answer.

fr.definition: Donner une réponse à quelqu’un plus tard.

de.definition: Einer Person später eine Antwort geben.

es.definition: Contestar a alguien más tarde.

pt.definition: Dar uma resposta a alguém mais tarde.

definition: To make something easier to understand by explaining it more clearly.
example: Could you clarify whether the revised budget includes the travel costs before we approve it?

fr.definition: Rendre quelque chose plus facile à comprendre en l’expliquant mieux.

de.definition: Etwas durch eine genauere Erklärung verständlicher machen.

es.definition: Hacer que algo se entienda mejor mediante una explicación más precisa.

pt.definition: Tornar algo mais fácil de compreender com uma explicação mais clara.

definition: To move a planned event to a later time or date.
example: We postponed the budget review until Friday because two key figures were missing.

fr.definition: Déplacer un événement à une date ultérieure.

de.definition: Einen geplanten Termin auf einen späteren Zeitpunkt verlegen.

es.definition: Dejar un acto previsto para una fecha posterior.

pt.definition: Passar um evento previsto para uma data posterior.

definition: To change the time or date set for an event.
example: The client asked us to reschedule the call for a time when her manager could join.

fr.definition: Changer la date ou l’heure prévue d’un événement.

de.definition: Einen neuen Termin für etwas festlegen.

es.definition: Cambiar la fecha o la hora prevista de algo.

pt.definition: Mudar a data ou a hora prevista de algo.

definition: To mention a problem or subject that needs attention.
example: I’d like to raise an issue about the new approval process before we sign off.

fr.definition: Attirer l’attention sur une difficulté qui doit être traitée.

de.definition: Auf eine Schwierigkeit aufmerksam machen, die behandelt werden muss.

es.definition: Exponer una dificultad para que se trate.

pt.definition: Chamar a atenção para um problema que precisa de ser tratado.

definition: To find a decision that all sides accept.
example: After comparing the costs, both teams reached an agreement on who would cover the extra hours.

fr.definition: Trouver une décision acceptée par toutes les parties.

de.definition: Eine gemeinsame Entscheidung finden, die alle Seiten akzeptieren.

es.definition: Encontrar una decisión que todas las partes acepten.

pt.definition: Encontrar uma decisão aceite por todas as partes.

definition: To finish work by the date it is due.
example: We need another designer if we're going to meet the deadline for the launch.

fr.definition: Terminer un travail avant la date prévue.

de.definition: Eine Arbeit bis zum festgelegten Termin abschließen.

es.definition: Terminar un trabajo antes de la fecha límite.

pt.definition: Terminar um trabalho até à data limite.

definition: The amount of work someone has to do.
example: Her workload doubled after two colleagues left, so she asked her manager to redistribute tasks.

fr.definition: Quantité de travail qu’une personne doit effectuer.

de.definition: Die Menge an Arbeit, die jemand erledigen muss.

es.definition: Cantidad de trabajo que una persona tiene que hacer.

pt.definition: Quantidade de trabalho que uma pessoa tem de fazer.

definition: A duty to take care of something or make sure it is done.
example: Managing the supplier relationship is my responsibility, so please send any concerns directly to me.

fr.definition: Obligation de s’occuper de quelque chose ou de veiller à ce qui doit être fait.

de.definition: Die Pflicht, sich um etwas zu kümmern oder für etwas zu sorgen.

es.definition: Obligación de ocuparse de algo o de asegurarse de que se haga.

pt.definition: Dever de tratar de algo ou de garantir que seja feito.

definition: A move to a more important or better-paid job.
example: He received a promotion after leading the office through a difficult system change.

fr.definition: Passage à un poste plus important ou mieux rémunéré.

de.definition: Der Wechsel in eine wichtigere oder besser bezahlte Stelle.

es.definition: Paso a un puesto de mayor importancia o mejor pagado.

pt.definition: Passagem para um cargo mais importante ou mais bem pago.

definition: To find and hire someone for a job.
example: We're hoping to recruit an experienced analyst before the new office opens.

fr.definition: Chercher et engager une personne pour un poste.

de.definition: Eine Person für eine Stelle finden und beschäftigen.

es.definition: Buscar y emplear a una persona para un puesto.

pt.definition: Procurar e contratar uma pessoa para um cargo.

definition: The process of finding and choosing people for jobs.
example: The recruitment process includes two interviews and a short task based on real client data.

fr.definition: Processus de recherche et de sélection de candidats pour des postes.

de.definition: Der Prozess, passende Personen für offene Stellen zu finden und auszuwählen.

es.definition: Proceso de buscar y seleccionar personas para cubrir puestos.

pt.definition: Processo de procurar e selecionar pessoas para preencher cargos.

definition: A person being considered for a job or position.
example: The hiring manager interviewed each candidate before choosing someone for the final round.

fr.definition: Personne qui postule à un emploi ou à un poste.

de.definition: Person, die sich um eine Stelle bewirbt.

es.definition: Persona que opta a un empleo o a un puesto.

pt.definition: Pessoa que se candidata a um emprego ou cargo.

definition: A person who can describe someone's work and character to a possible employer.
example: We need a professional reference who can confirm your experience leading large projects.

fr.definition: Personne qui renseigne un employeur sur le travail d’un candidat.

de.definition: Person, die einem möglichen Arbeitgeber Auskunft über jemanden gibt.

es.definition: Persona que informa a un posible empleador sobre un candidato.

pt.definition: Pessoa que dá informações sobre um candidato a um possível empregador.

definition: How well someone does their job or completes a task.
example: Her performance improved after the team agreed on clearer priorities and weekly check-ins.

fr.definition: Qualité du travail réalisé ou d’une tâche accomplie.

de.definition: Wie gut jemand seine Arbeit oder eine Aufgabe erledigt.

es.definition: Calidad con la que alguien realiza su trabajo o una tarea.

pt.definition: Qualidade com que alguém realiza o seu trabalho ou uma tarefa.

definition: A result or amount that someone is expected to achieve.
example: The sales team missed its quarterly target because two major clients delayed their orders.

fr.definition: Résultat ou niveau qu’une personne ou une équipe doit atteindre.

de.definition: Ergebnis oder Menge, die jemand erreichen soll.

es.definition: Resultado o cantidad que alguien debe alcanzar.

pt.definition: Resultado ou quantidade que alguém deve alcançar.

definition: Paid time off work that an employee can take each year.
example: I’ve booked my annual leave for August, so please avoid scheduling the launch then.

fr.definition: Jours de repos rémunérés auxquels un salarié a droit chaque année.

de.definition: Bezahlte freie Tage, die Beschäftigte jedes Jahr nehmen können.

es.definition: Días libres pagados que un trabajador puede disfrutar cada año.

pt.definition: Dias de descanso pagos a que um trabalhador tem direito todos os anos.

definition: Time away from work that is allowed when an employee is ill.
example: He took sick leave for three days and asked a colleague to cover his calls.

fr.definition: Absence autorisée du travail pour cause de maladie.

de.definition: Zeit, in der jemand wegen einer Krankheit nicht arbeitet.

es.definition: Ausencia del trabajo autorizada por motivos de salud.

pt.definition: Ausência do trabalho por motivo de doença.

definition: A way of organizing work with adaptable hours or locations.
example: Flexible working helps our team coordinate across time zones without requiring everyone online together.

fr.definition: Organisation du travail qui permet d’adapter les horaires ou le lieu.

de.definition: Arbeitsform mit anpassbaren Zeiten oder Arbeitsorten.

es.definition: Forma de organizar el trabajo con horarios o lugares adaptables.

pt.definition: Forma de organizar o trabalho com horários ou locais adaptáveis.

definition: Doing your job from a place outside your employer’s usual workplace.
example: Remote working has reduced office costs, but new employees still need regular support.

fr.definition: Travail effectué à distance, hors des locaux habituels de l’employeur.

de.definition: Arbeiten an einem Ort außerhalb des üblichen Arbeitsplatzes.

es.definition: Trabajo realizado desde un lugar distinto al centro de trabajo habitual.

pt.definition: Trabalho realizado fora do local habitual de trabalho.

definition: A set of rules that guides decisions and actions in an organization.
example: Our remote-work policy allows employees to work from home twice a week.

fr.definition: Ensemble de règles qui guide les décisions et les actions d’une entreprise.

de.definition: Regeln, die Entscheidungen und Handlungen in einem Unternehmen leiten.

es.definition: Conjunto de normas que orienta las decisiones y acciones de una empresa.

pt.definition: Conjunto de regras que orienta as decisões e ações de uma empresa.

definition: An agreed series of steps for completing a task correctly.
example: Follow the expense procedure and attach every receipt before sending your claim.

fr.definition: Suite d’étapes à suivre pour effectuer correctement une tâche.

de.definition: Festgelegte Schritte, mit denen eine Aufgabe richtig erledigt wird.

es.definition: Serie de pasos acordados para realizar correctamente una tarea.

pt.definition: Série de passos definidos para realizar corretamente uma tarefa.

definition: To make a process or task easier to do.
example: The new booking system should facilitate room changes when client meetings run over.

fr.definition: Rendre une tâche ou une démarche plus facile.

de.definition: Eine Aufgabe oder einen Ablauf einfacher machen.

es.definition: Hacer que una tarea o un proceso resulte más fácil.

pt.definition: Tornar uma tarefa ou um processo mais fácil.

definition: To organize people or activities so they work well together.
example: Maya will coordinate the designers and engineers so both teams can meet the launch date.

fr.definition: Organiser des personnes ou des activités pour qu’elles fonctionnent ensemble.

de.definition: Personen oder Tätigkeiten so organisieren, dass sie gut zusammenarbeiten.

es.definition: Organizar personas o actividades para que trabajen bien juntas.

pt.definition: Organizar pessoas ou atividades para trabalharem bem em conjunto.

definition: To give a task or responsibility to someone else.
example: Rather than edit every report herself, Lena delegated the first review to her analyst.

fr.definition: Confier une tâche ou une responsabilité à quelqu’un d’autre.

de.definition: Eine Aufgabe oder Verantwortung einer anderen Person übertragen.

es.definition: Encargar una tarea o responsabilidad a otra persona.

pt.definition: Atribuir uma tarefa ou responsabilidade a outra pessoa.

definition: To watch work and make sure it is done properly.
example: Jon will oversee the office move, checking that equipment arrives before staff return.

fr.definition: Suivre un travail et veiller à ce qu’il soit bien fait.

de.definition: Eine Arbeit beobachten und darauf achten, dass sie richtig erledigt wird.

es.definition: Vigilar un trabajo y comprobar que se hace correctamente.

pt.definition: Acompanhar um trabalho e garantir que é bem feito.

definition: To put a plan or decision into action.
example: We plan to implement the revised approval process next month, after training all managers.

fr.definition: Commencer à appliquer un plan ou une décision.

de.definition: Einen Plan oder eine Entscheidung in die Praxis bringen.

es.definition: Poner en práctica un plan o una decisión.

pt.definition: Pôr um plano ou uma decisão em prática.

definition: To make a process simpler and more efficient.
example: The team streamlined invoice checks, cutting approval time from five days to two.

fr.definition: Simplifier un processus pour le rendre plus efficace.

de.definition: Einen Ablauf einfacher und effizienter machen.

es.definition: Hacer que un proceso sea más sencillo y eficiente.

pt.definition: Tornar um processo mais simples e eficiente.

definition: To give resources or tasks to particular people or purposes.
example: Finance allocated extra funds to the support team after customer requests doubled.

fr.definition: Donner des ressources ou des tâches à des personnes ou à des fins précises.

de.definition: Ressourcen oder Aufgaben bestimmten Personen oder Zwecken geben.

es.definition: Dar recursos o tareas a personas o fines concretos.

pt.definition: Destinar recursos ou tarefas a pessoas ou objetivos específicos.

definition: To communicate and coordinate work with another person or group.
example: I’ll liaise with the finance team and send you their figures before the meeting.

fr.definition: Communiquer et coordonner le travail avec une personne ou une équipe.

de.definition: Mit einer Person oder Gruppe kommunizieren und die Zusammenarbeit koordinieren.

es.definition: Comunicarse y coordinar el trabajo con otra persona o grupo.

pt.definition: Comunicar e coordenar o trabalho com outra pessoa ou equipa.

definition: A person or group affected by or involved in a business decision.
example: Each stakeholder received a progress note, including the client, the finance lead, and staff representatives.

fr.definition: Personne ou groupe concerné par une décision ou une activité.

de.definition: Person oder Gruppe, die von einer Entscheidung betroffen ist oder daran beteiligt ist.

es.definition: Persona o grupo afectado por una decisión o que participa en ella.

pt.definition: Pessoa ou grupo afetado por uma decisão ou envolvido nela.

definition: A piece of work that must be completed and given to a client or team.
example: The final deliverable is a training guide that managers can use with new hires.

fr.definition: Travail à terminer et à remettre à un client ou à une équipe.

de.definition: Eine Arbeit, die fertiggestellt und einem Kunden oder Team übergeben werden muss.

es.definition: Trabajo que debe completarse y entregarse a un cliente o equipo.

pt.definition: Trabalho que deve ser concluído e entregue a um cliente ou equipa.

definition: A shared decision that most or all members of a group can support.
example: After an hour of discussion, the team reached a consensus on the launch date.

fr.definition: Un accord partagé par les membres d’un groupe.

de.definition: Eine gemeinsame Entscheidung, die eine Gruppe unterstützt.

es.definition: Un acuerdo que los miembros de un grupo pueden apoyar.

pt.definition: Um acordo que os membros de um grupo podem apoiar.

definition: Likely to cause strong disagreement.
example: The proposed changes to the bonus scheme became contentious during the meeting.

fr.definition: Qui suscite de nombreux désaccords.

de.definition: Von vielen Menschen kritisiert oder abgelehnt.

es.definition: Que provoca desacuerdos o discusiones.

pt.definition: Que provoca desacordos ou discussões.

definition: Written messages exchanged between people or organisations.
example: Please copy Maya on all correspondence about the revised contract.

fr.definition: Ensemble des lettres et messages échangés.

de.definition: Schriftliche Nachrichten zwischen Personen oder Organisationen.

es.definition: Conjunto de mensajes escritos que se intercambian.

pt.definition: Conjunto de mensagens escritas que se trocam.

definition: To make changes so someone's needs or wishes can be met.
example: We can accommodate your request by moving the review to Friday.

fr.definition: Tenir compte d’un besoin ou d’une demande.

de.definition: Auf einen Wunsch oder Bedarf eingehen.

es.definition: Dar respuesta a una necesidad o petición.

pt.definition: Adaptar algo para satisfazer uma necessidade ou pedido.

definition: Using few words while still giving the needed information.
example: Please keep your update concise so we can finish the meeting on time.

fr.definition: Qui exprime l’essentiel en peu de mots.

de.definition: Kurz und klar formuliert.

es.definition: Que expresa lo esencial con pocas palabras.

pt.definition: Que exprime o essencial em poucas palavras.

definition: A new offer made in reply to another offer.
example: They rejected our first proposal but sent a counteroffer with a later start date.

fr.definition: Nouvelle proposition faite en réponse à une offre.

de.definition: Ein neues Angebot als Antwort auf ein anderes.

es.definition: Nueva oferta presentada como respuesta a otra.

pt.definition: Nova proposta feita em resposta a outra.

definition: Something given up to help reach an agreement.
example: As a concession, we agreed to extend the payment period by two weeks.

fr.definition: Ce qu’on accepte de céder pour parvenir à un accord.

de.definition: Etwas, worauf man für eine Einigung verzichtet.

es.definition: Algo que se cede para llegar a un acuerdo.

pt.definition: Algo a que se renuncia para chegar a um acordo.

definition: The rules and details that explain an agreement or service.
example: Before signing, read the terms and conditions carefully, especially the cancellation clause.

fr.definition: Les règles qui précisent un accord ou un service.

de.definition: Regeln, die einen Vertrag oder eine Dienstleistung erklären.

es.definition: Las reglas que explican un acuerdo o servicio.

pt.definition: As regras que explicam um acordo ou serviço.

definition: Not open to change or discussion.
example: For security reasons, two-factor authentication is non-negotiable for every staff account.

fr.definition: Qui ne peut être modifié ni discuté.

de.definition: Nicht offen für Änderungen oder Diskussionen.

es.definition: Que no se puede cambiar ni discutir.

pt.definition: Que não pode ser alterado nem discutido.

definition: Helping each side gain something useful.
example: The revised schedule was mutually beneficial, giving both teams more time to prepare.

fr.definition: Qui apporte des avantages à chacune des parties.

de.definition: So, dass beide Seiten einen Vorteil haben.

es.definition: Que aporta ventajas a todas las partes.

pt.definition: Que traz vantagens para todas as partes.

definition: A task agreed in a meeting, assigned to someone, and expected to be completed.
example: Please add the revised budget as an action point and give it to Marta.

fr.definition: Une tâche décidée en réunion et confiée à une personne.

de.definition: Eine in einer Besprechung vereinbarte Aufgabe, für deren Erledigung jemand zuständig ist.

es.definition: Una tarea acordada en una reunión y asignada a una persona.

pt.definition: Uma tarefa acordada numa reunião e atribuída a alguém.

definition: Send a problem to someone at a higher level for help or a decision.
example: If the vendor misses another deadline, we may need to escalate the issue to senior management.

fr.definition: Transmettre un problème à une personne occupant un poste supérieur.

de.definition: Ein Problem an eine Person auf einer höheren Ebene weitergeben.

es.definition: Trasladar un problema a una persona de nivel superior.

pt.definition: Passar um problema para alguém num nível hierárquico superior.

definition: A formal review of an employee’s work, skills, and progress.
example: My annual appraisal highlighted strong client feedback and set two goals for the next quarter.

fr.definition: Un examen formel du travail, des compétences et des progrès d’un salarié.

de.definition: Eine formelle Bewertung der Arbeit, Fähigkeiten und Fortschritte eines Beschäftigten.

definition: A win that costs so much it is almost a defeat.
example: The company won the lawsuit, but the legal fees made it a Pyrrhic victory.

fr.definition: Victoire obtenue à un prix si élevé qu'elle ressemble à une défaite.

de.definition: Ein Sieg, der so viel kostet, dass er fast eine Niederlage ist.

es.definition: Victoria que cuesta tanto que casi es una derrota.

pt.definition: Vitória que custa tanto que quase é uma derrota.

definition: A weak point that can cause failure.
example: Poor customer service has become the airline's Achilles' heel.

fr.definition: Point faible qui peut causer l'échec.

de.definition: Eine Schwachstelle, die zum Scheitern führen kann.

es.definition: Punto débil que puede causar el fracaso.

pt.definition: Ponto fraco que pode causar o fracasso.

definition: Something that distracts attention from the real issue.
example: The debate about the logo was a red herring; the real problem was the price.

fr.definition: Élément qui détourne l'attention du vrai problème.

de.definition: Etwas, das vom eigentlichen Problem ablenkt.

es.definition: Algo que desvía la atención del problema real.

pt.definition: Algo que desvia a atenção do problema real.

definition: Pretending not to want something because you cannot have it.
example: He says the promotion wasn't worth it, but that's just sour grapes.

fr.definition: Dénigrer ce qu'on ne peut pas obtenir.

de.definition: So tun, als wolle man nicht, was man nicht bekommen kann.

es.definition: Despreciar lo que no se puede conseguir.

pt.definition: Desdenhar o que não se consegue obter.

definition: A very difficult first experience of something new.
example: Her first week as a nurse, during a flu outbreak, was a baptism of fire.

fr.definition: Première expérience très difficile de quelque chose de nouveau.

de.definition: Eine sehr schwierige erste Erfahrung mit etwas Neuem.

es.definition: Primera experiencia muy difícil de algo nuevo.

pt.definition: Primeira experiência muito difícil de algo novo.

definition: A question that no longer matters or cannot be settled.
example: Whether we should have hired him is a moot point now that he has resigned.

fr.definition: Question qui n'a plus d'importance ou ne peut être tranchée.

de.definition: Eine Frage, die keine Rolle mehr spielt.

es.definition: Asunto que ya no importa o no se puede resolver.

pt.definition: Questão que já não interessa ou não se pode resolver.

definition: Criticise someone indirectly by praising them very weakly.
example: Calling his novel "perfectly readable" was damning it with faint praise.

fr.definition: Critiquer quelqu'un en le louant très faiblement.

de.definition: Jemanden indirekt kritisieren, indem man ihn nur schwach lobt.

es.definition: Criticar a alguien de forma indirecta con un elogio muy débil.

pt.definition: Criticar alguém de forma indireta com um elogio muito fraco.

definition: Stop trying because you are satisfied with past success.
example: After winning the award, the team didn't rest on their laurels.

fr.definition: Cesser de faire des efforts après un succès.

de.definition: Nach einem Erfolg keine Mühe mehr geben.

es.definition: Dejar de esforzarse tras un éxito.

pt.definition: Deixar de se esforçar depois de um sucesso.

definition: The study of human societies, cultures and how they develop.
example: She studied anthropology to understand how rituals shape community life.

fr.definition: Étude des sociétés humaines, de leurs cultures et de leur évolution.

de.definition: Die Wissenschaft von menschlichen Gesellschaften und Kulturen.

es.definition: Estudio de las sociedades humanas, sus culturas y su evolución.

pt.definition: Estudo das sociedades humanas, das suas culturas e da sua evolução.

definition: Having several centres of power or activity rather than one.
example: The region developed as a polycentric network of small cities instead of one capital.

fr.definition: Qui a plusieurs centres de pouvoir ou d'activité.

de.definition: Mit mehreren Macht- oder Aktivitätszentren statt einem.

es.definition: Que tiene varios centros de poder o actividad.

pt.definition: Que tem vários centros de poder ou de atividade.

definition: Found everywhere, so common that people hardly notice it.
example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous, even in remote mountain villages.

fr.definition: Présent partout, au point qu'on ne le remarque plus.

de.definition: Überall vorhanden, so dass man es kaum noch bemerkt.

es.definition: Presente en todas partes, tan común que apenas se nota.

pt.definition: Presente em todo o lado, tão comum que quase não se nota.

definition: The part of philosophy that asks how we know things and what counts as knowledge.
example: Her thesis examines the epistemology of scientific models in climate research.

fr.definition: Branche de la philosophie qui étudie la nature de la connaissance.

de.definition: Teil der Philosophie, der fragt, wie wir etwas wissen.

es.definition: Rama de la filosofía que estudia cómo conocemos las cosas.

pt.definition: Ramo da filosofia que estuda como conhecemos as coisas.

definition: Strong control or influence of one group or country over others.
example: The essay traces the cultural hegemony of Hollywood after the Second World War.

fr.definition: Domination d'un groupe ou d'un pays sur les autres.

de.definition: Die Vorherrschaft einer Gruppe oder eines Landes über andere.

es.definition: Dominio de un grupo o país sobre otros.

pt.definition: Domínio de um grupo ou país sobre os outros.

definition: A simple rule of thumb that helps people make decisions quickly.
example: Shoppers often rely on a heuristic such as choosing the middle-priced option.

fr.definition: Règle simple qui aide à décider rapidement.

de.definition: Eine einfache Faustregel für schnelle Entscheidungen.

es.definition: Regla sencilla que ayuda a decidir con rapidez.

pt.definition: Regra simples que ajuda a decidir rapidamente.

definition: The part of philosophy that studies what exists and what kinds of things are real.
example: The debate turns on the ontology of numbers: do they exist independently of us?

fr.definition: Branche de la philosophie qui étudie ce qui existe.

de.definition: Teil der Philosophie, der untersucht, was existiert.

es.definition: Rama de la filosofía que estudia lo que existe.

pt.definition: Ramo da filosofia que estuda o que existe.

definition: Insisting that your beliefs are right and refusing to consider other views.
example: The reviewer found the author too dogmatic to engage with opposing evidence.

fr.definition: Qui impose ses idées sans accepter la discussion.

de.definition: Auf den eigenen Überzeugungen beharrend, ohne andere Ansichten zu prüfen.

es.definition: Que impone sus ideas sin aceptar otras opiniones.

pt.definition: Que impõe as suas ideias sem aceitar outras opiniões.

definition: Understood only by a small group with special knowledge.
example: The lecture was too esoteric for anyone outside the field of medieval law.

fr.definition: Compris seulement par un petit groupe de spécialistes.

de.definition: Nur für einen kleinen Kreis von Eingeweihten verständlich.

es.definition: Comprensible solo para un pequeño grupo de especialistas.

pt.definition: Compreensível apenas para um pequeno grupo de especialistas.

definition: A system for sorting things into ordered groups.
example: The researchers proposed a new taxonomy of online misinformation.

fr.definition: Système de classement en catégories ordonnées.

de.definition: Ein System zur Einteilung in geordnete Gruppen.

es.definition: Sistema para clasificar cosas en grupos ordenados.

pt.definition: Sistema para classificar coisas em grupos ordenados.

definition: Something that belongs to a different period of time from the one it appears in.
example: A wristwatch in a film about ancient Rome is an obvious anachronism.

fr.definition: Élément qui n'appartient pas à l'époque où il apparaît.

de.definition: Etwas, das nicht in die Zeit passt, in der es vorkommt.

es.definition: Algo que no corresponde a la época en que aparece.

pt.definition: Algo que não pertence à época em que aparece.

definition: A basic statement accepted as true without needing proof.
example: The model rests on the axiom that people act in their own interest.

fr.definition: Principe de base admis comme vrai sans démonstration.

de.definition: Ein Grundsatz, der ohne Beweis als wahr gilt.

es.definition: Principio básico que se acepta como verdadero sin prueba.

pt.definition: Princípio básico aceite como verdadeiro sem prova.

definition: Clear, logical and convincing.
example: She presented a cogent case for investing in public transport.

fr.definition: Clair, logique et persuasif.

de.definition: Klar, logisch und überzeugend.

es.definition: Claro, lógico y persuasivo.

pt.definition: Claro, lógico e persuasivo.

definition: Meant to teach, sometimes in a way that feels like lecturing.
example: The novel's didactic tone makes its moral lessons feel heavy-handed.

fr.definition: Destiné à enseigner, parfois de façon moralisatrice.

de.definition: Belehrend, manchmal auf eine aufdringliche Art.

es.definition: Pensado para enseñar, a veces de forma sermoneadora.

pt.definition: Destinado a ensinar, por vezes de forma moralista.

definition: Having or showing great knowledge from long study.
example: The professor's erudite introduction referred to sources in six languages.

fr.definition: Qui a de vastes connaissances acquises par l'étude.

de.definition: Mit großem Wissen aus langem Studium.

es.definition: Que tiene grandes conocimientos adquiridos por el estudio.

pt.definition: Que tem grandes conhecimentos adquiridos pelo estudo.

definition: Unusual and typical of one particular person or thing.
example: His idiosyncratic spelling made the old letters easy to identify.

fr.definition: Propre à une personne et assez inhabituel.

de.definition: Ungewöhnlich und typisch für eine bestimmte Person.

es.definition: Peculiar y propio de una persona concreta.

pt.definition: Peculiar e próprio de uma pessoa concreta.

definition: Strange because it does not fit with its surroundings.
example: A glass tower looks incongruous among the old stone houses.

fr.definition: Étrange parce qu'il ne va pas avec ce qui l'entoure.

de.definition: Seltsam, weil es nicht zur Umgebung passt.

es.definition: Extraño porque no encaja con lo que lo rodea.

pt.definition: Estranho por não combinar com o que o rodeia.

definition: Just starting to exist and not yet fully developed.
example: The country's nascent tech industry still depends on foreign investment.

fr.definition: Qui commence à exister et n'est pas encore développé.

de.definition: Gerade entstehend und noch nicht voll entwickelt.

es.definition: Que empieza a existir y aún no está desarrollado.

pt.definition: Que começa a existir e ainda não está desenvolvido.

definition: To make something deliberately unclear or hard to understand.
example: The report uses technical language to obfuscate its weak results.

fr.definition: Rendre volontairement quelque chose confus.

de.definition: Etwas absichtlich unklar machen.

es.definition: Hacer algo confuso a propósito.

pt.definition: Tornar algo confuso de propósito.

definition: A shortage of something that is needed.
example: The paucity of reliable records makes the period hard to reconstruct.

fr.definition: Manque de quelque chose de nécessaire.

de.definition: Ein Fehlen von etwas, das gebraucht wird.

es.definition: Falta de algo necesario.

pt.definition: Falta de algo necessário.

definition: Harmful in a gradual way that is hard to notice.
example: The study describes the pernicious effect of constant notifications on attention.

fr.definition: Nuisible de façon lente et discrète.

de.definition: Auf schleichende, kaum merkliche Weise schädlich.

es.definition: Dañino de forma gradual y poco visible.

pt.definition: Nocivo de forma gradual e pouco visível.

definition: Based on a particular idea or condition being true.
example: The plan is predicated on the assumption that interest rates will stay low.

fr.definition: Qui repose sur une idée ou une condition.

de.definition: Auf einer bestimmten Annahme oder Bedingung aufgebaut.

es.definition: Que se apoya en una idea o condición.

pt.definition: Que se baseia numa ideia ou condição.

definition: Being the most typical example of something.
example: The small café with mismatched chairs is the quintessential student hangout.

fr.definition: Qui représente l'exemple le plus typique.

de.definition: Das typischste Beispiel für etwas.

es.definition: Que es el ejemplo más típico de algo.

pt.definition: Que é o exemplo mais típico de algo.

definition: Making a complex issue seem too simple.
example: Blaming the crisis on one politician is a reductive explanation.

fr.definition: Qui simplifie trop une question complexe.

de.definition: Eine komplexe Frage zu stark vereinfachend.

es.definition: Que simplifica demasiado un asunto complejo.

pt.definition: Que simplifica demasiado uma questão complexa.

definition: False, though it may look genuine or logical.
example: The article draws a spurious link between chocolate and exam success.

fr.definition: Faux, même s'il semble vrai ou logique.

de.definition: Falsch, auch wenn es echt oder logisch wirkt.

es.definition: Falso, aunque parezca auténtico o lógico.

pt.definition: Falso, embora pareça autêntico ou lógico.

definition: Understood without being said aloud.
example: There was a tacit agreement that nobody would mention the budget.

fr.definition: Compris sans être dit.

de.definition: Verstanden, ohne ausgesprochen zu werden.

es.definition: Que se entiende sin decirse.

pt.definition: Que se entende sem ser dito.

definition: The idea of explaining things by the purpose they seem to serve.
example: Critics reject the teleology of stories that present history as steady progress.

fr.definition: Explication des choses par leur but.

de.definition: Die Erklärung von Dingen durch ihren Zweck.

es.definition: Explicación de las cosas por su finalidad.

pt.definition: Explicação das coisas pela sua finalidade.

definition: The quality of being true or accurate.
example: Journalists checked the veracity of the video before publishing it.

fr.definition: Qualité de ce qui est vrai ou exact.

de.definition: Die Eigenschaft, wahr oder genau zu sein.

es.definition: Cualidad de ser verdadero o exacto.

pt.definition: Qualidade do que é verdadeiro ou exato.

definition: The general mood and ideas typical of a particular period.
example: The album captured the anxious zeitgeist of the early pandemic.

fr.definition: État d'esprit typique d'une époque.

de.definition: Die typische Stimmung und Denkweise einer Epoche.

es.definition: Ambiente e ideas típicos de un periodo.

pt.definition: Ambiente e ideias típicos de um período.

definition: The study of how texts and meanings are interpreted.
example: The seminar applies hermeneutics to legal texts as well as literature.

fr.definition: Étude de l'interprétation des textes.

de.definition: Die Lehre vom Auslegen von Texten.

es.definition: Estudio de la interpretación de los textos.

pt.definition: Estudo da interpretação dos textos.

definition: Made up of parts that are very different from each other.
example: The sample was heterogeneous, including students, retirees and shift workers.

fr.definition: Composé d'éléments très différents.

de.definition: Aus sehr unterschiedlichen Teilen bestehend.

es.definition: Formado por elementos muy distintos.

pt.definition: Formado por elementos muito diferentes.

definition: Made up of parts that are all very similar.
example: The survey group was too homogeneous to reflect the wider population.

fr.definition: Composé d'éléments très semblables.

de.definition: Aus sehr ähnlichen Teilen bestehend.

es.definition: Formado por elementos muy parecidos.

pt.definition: Formado por elementos muito semelhantes.

definition: So closely connected that the parts cannot be separated.
example: In her view, economic and environmental questions are inextricable.

fr.definition: Si lié qu'on ne peut pas le séparer.

de.definition: So eng verbunden, dass man es nicht trennen kann.

es.definition: Tan unido que no se puede separar.

pt.definition: Tão ligado que não se pode separar.

definition: Very difficult to solve or deal with.
example: Housing shortages have proved intractable despite decades of reform.

fr.definition: Très difficile à résoudre.

de.definition: Sehr schwer zu lösen oder zu bewältigen.

es.definition: Muy difícil de resolver.

pt.definition: Muito difícil de resolver.

definition: To increase quickly in number.
example: Fact-checking websites proliferated after the election.

fr.definition: Se multiplier rapidement.

de.definition: Schnell an Zahl zunehmen.

es.definition: Multiplicarse con rapidez.

pt.definition: Multiplicar-se rapidamente.

definition: Reaching the truth by setting opposing ideas against each other.
example: The book follows a dialectical structure, moving from thesis to counterargument.

fr.definition: Qui avance en confrontant des idées opposées.

de.definition: Durch die Gegenüberstellung gegensätzlicher Ideen zur Wahrheit gelangend.

es.definition: Que busca la verdad enfrentando ideas opuestas.

pt.definition: Que procura a verdade confrontando ideias opostas.

definition: Clever arguments that sound good but are actually false.
example: The minister's defence was dismissed as mere sophistry.

fr.definition: Raisonnements habiles mais trompeurs.

de.definition: Geschickte, aber irreführende Argumente.

es.definition: Argumentos ingeniosos pero engañosos.

pt.definition: Argumentos engenhosos mas enganadores.

definition: The quality of seeming true or real.
example: Detailed street names give the novel a strong sense of verisimilitude.

fr.definition: Qualité de ce qui paraît vrai ou réel.

de.definition: Der Eindruck, wahr oder echt zu sein.

es.definition: Cualidad de parecer verdadero o real.

pt.definition: Qualidade do que parece verdadeiro ou real.

definition: Very suitable for the situation.
example: The speaker ended with an apposite quotation about patience.

fr.definition: Parfaitement adapté à la situation.

de.definition: Genau passend zur Situation.

es.definition: Muy adecuado a la situación.

pt.definition: Muito adequado à situação.

definition: To limit something within clear boundaries.
example: The committee's powers are tightly circumscribed by the constitution.

fr.definition: Limiter à l'intérieur de bornes précises.

de.definition: Etwas innerhalb klarer Grenzen halten.

es.definition: Limitar algo dentro de fronteras claras.

pt.definition: Limitar algo dentro de fronteiras claras.

definition: Based on observation or experiment rather than theory alone.
example: The claim sounds reasonable, but there is little empirical evidence for it.

fr.definition: Fondé sur l'observation ou l'expérience.

de.definition: Auf Beobachtung oder Experiment beruhend.

es.definition: Basado en la observación o la experiencia.

pt.definition: Baseado na observação ou na experiência.

definition: To make a bad situation even worse.
example: Cutting bus routes would exacerbate isolation in rural areas.

fr.definition: Rendre une mauvaise situation encore pire.

de.definition: Eine schlechte Lage noch schlimmer machen.

es.definition: Empeorar una situación que ya era mala.

pt.definition: Tornar pior uma situação que já era má.

definition: To make something harmful less serious.
example: Planting trees can mitigate the effects of summer heat in cities.

fr.definition: Rendre quelque chose de nuisible moins grave.

de.definition: Etwas Schädliches weniger schlimm machen.

es.definition: Hacer que algo dañino sea menos grave.

pt.definition: Tornar algo prejudicial menos grave.

definition: Never having happened before.
example: The storm caused unprecedented damage to the coastline.

fr.definition: Qui n'est jamais arrivé auparavant.

de.definition: So noch nie da gewesen.

es.definition: Que nunca había ocurrido antes.

pt.definition: Que nunca tinha acontecido antes.

definition: Reasonable and likely to be true.
example: Her explanation for the delay sounded plausible, so nobody questioned it.

fr.definition: Raisonnable et probablement vrai.

de.definition: Vernünftig und wahrscheinlich wahr.

es.definition: Razonable y probablemente cierto.

pt.definition: Razoável e provavelmente verdadeiro.

definition: Dealing with real, important matters rather than details.
example: The meeting produced no substantive changes to the proposal.

fr.definition: Qui touche aux questions importantes, pas aux détails.

de.definition: Wesentliche, wichtige Punkte betreffend.

es.definition: Que trata asuntos importantes y no detalles.

pt.definition: Que trata de questões importantes e não de pormenores.

definition: Dealing with problems in a practical way rather than by theory.
example: The council took a pragmatic approach and fixed the worst roads first.

fr.definition: Qui traite les problèmes de façon concrète.

de.definition: Probleme praktisch statt theoretisch angehend.

es.definition: Que resuelve los problemas de forma práctica.

pt.definition: Que resolve os problemas de forma prática.

definition: Having mixed feelings about something.
example: Many residents feel ambivalent about the new stadium near their homes.

fr.definition: Qui ressent des sentiments contradictoires.

de.definition: Mit gemischten Gefühlen gegenüber etwas.

es.definition: Que tiene sentimientos contradictorios.

pt.definition: Que tem sentimentos contraditórios.

definition: Based on chance or personal choice rather than reason.
example: The cut-off age of 25 seems arbitrary and is not explained in the report.

fr.definition: Qui dépend du hasard ou d'un choix personnel.

de.definition: Auf Zufall oder persönlicher Laune statt auf Gründen beruhend.

es.definition: Que depende del azar o de un capricho, no de razones.

pt.definition: Que depende do acaso ou de um capricho, e não de razões.

definition: A difference between things that should be the same.
example: Auditors found a discrepancy between the invoices and the bank records.

fr.definition: Différence entre des choses qui devraient concorder.

de.definition: Ein Unterschied zwischen Dingen, die übereinstimmen sollten.

es.definition: Diferencia entre cosas que deberían coincidir.

pt.definition: Diferença entre coisas que deviam coincidir.

definition: To work together so the result is greater than each part alone.
example: The two teams synergized well, combining design skills with technical knowledge.

fr.definition: Coopérer pour obtenir plus que chacun seul.

de.definition: So zusammenarbeiten, dass das Ergebnis größer ist als die Teile.

es.definition: Colaborar para lograr más de lo que cada parte lograría sola.

pt.definition: Colaborar para conseguir mais do que cada parte sozinha.

definition: A standard used to measure or compare performance.
example: Last year's sales figures serve as the benchmark for this quarter.

fr.definition: Norme qui sert à mesurer ou comparer des résultats.

de.definition: Ein Standard, an dem Leistung gemessen wird.

es.definition: Estándar para medir o comparar resultados.

pt.definition: Padrão usado para medir ou comparar resultados.

definition: Able to grow larger without losing efficiency.
example: Investors want a scalable business that can expand to new markets quickly.

fr.definition: Capable de grandir sans perdre en efficacité.

de.definition: Wachstumsfähig, ohne an Effizienz zu verlieren.

es.definition: Capaz de crecer sin perder eficacia.

pt.definition: Capaz de crescer sem perder eficiência.

definition: The process of helping new employees settle into a job.
example: Good onboarding helps new staff feel confident in their first month.

fr.definition: Processus d'accueil des nouveaux salariés.

de.definition: Das Einführen neuer Mitarbeiter in ihre Arbeit.

es.definition: Proceso para integrar a los nuevos empleados.

pt.definition: Processo de acolhimento de novos colaboradores.

definition: A point where work slows down because too much must pass through it.
example: Approval by a single manager became a bottleneck for every project.

fr.definition: Point où le travail ralentit à cause d'un blocage.

de.definition: Eine Stelle, an der sich Arbeit staut.

es.definition: Punto donde el trabajo se atasca.

pt.definition: Ponto onde o trabalho abranda por causa de um bloqueio.

definition: To encourage people to do something by offering a reward.
example: The company incentivizes cycling to work with a monthly bonus.

fr.definition: Encourager en offrant une récompense.

de.definition: Durch eine Belohnung zu etwas ermutigen.

es.definition: Animar a hacer algo ofreciendo una recompensa.

pt.definition: Encorajar a fazer algo oferecendo uma recompensa.

definition: To pay another company to do work instead of doing it yourself.
example: The firm outsources its IT support to a company abroad.

fr.definition: Confier un travail à une autre entreprise.

de.definition: Arbeit an eine andere Firma vergeben.

es.definition: Encargar un trabajo a otra empresa.

pt.definition: Entregar um trabalho a outra empresa.

definition: Official authority or permission to carry out a task.
example: The new board has a clear mandate to cut costs.

fr.definition: Autorisation officielle de mener une mission.

de.definition: Offizieller Auftrag oder Befugnis für eine Aufgabe.

es.definition: Autoridad oficial para llevar a cabo una tarea.

pt.definition: Autorização oficial para cumprir uma tarefa.

definition: The rate at which employees leave and have to be replaced.
example: High staff turnover makes it hard to keep experienced people.

fr.word: le taux de rotation du personnel
fr.definition: Rythme auquel les salariés partent et sont remplacés.

de.definition: Die Rate, mit der Mitarbeiter gehen und ersetzt werden.

es.definition: Ritmo al que los empleados se van y se sustituyen.

pt.definition: Ritmo a que os trabalhadores saem e são substituídos.

definition: Openness about decisions and information, so others can see what happens.
example: Staff asked for more transparency about how bonuses are calculated.

fr.definition: Ouverture sur les décisions et les informations.

de.definition: Offenheit bei Entscheidungen und Informationen.

es.definition: Apertura sobre decisiones e información.

pt.definition: Abertura sobre decisões e informações.

definition: To find a way of earning money from something.
example: The app has millions of users but has not yet found a way to monetize them.

fr.definition: Trouver un moyen de gagner de l'argent avec quelque chose.

de.definition: Einen Weg finden, mit etwas Geld zu verdienen.

es.definition: Encontrar una forma de ganar dinero con algo.

pt.definition: Encontrar maneira de ganhar dinheiro com algo.

definition: The area of work that a person or group is responsible for.
example: Customer complaints fall outside the remit of the finance team.

fr.definition: Domaine dont une personne ou un groupe est responsable.

de.definition: Der Bereich, für den jemand verantwortlich ist.

es.definition: Área de la que es responsable una persona o grupo.

pt.definition: Área pela qual uma pessoa ou grupo é responsável.

definition: Related to government or company money, especially taxes and spending.
example: The fiscal year ends in March, so budgets are set in February.

fr.definition: Relatif aux finances, surtout aux impôts et dépenses.

de.definition: Die öffentlichen Finanzen, Steuern und Ausgaben betreffend.

es.definition: Relativo a las finanzas, sobre todo impuestos y gastos.

pt.definition: Relativo às finanças, sobretudo impostos e despesas.

definition: To spread the cost of something over a period of time.
example: The company will amortize the new software over five years.

fr.definition: Répartir un coût sur une certaine période.

de.definition: Kosten über einen Zeitraum verteilen.

es.definition: Repartir un coste a lo largo de un periodo.

pt.definition: Distribuir um custo ao longo de um período.

es.definition: Sufrir una derrota final y decisiva.

pt.definition: Sofrer uma derrota final e decisiva.

definition: Solve a complicated problem in a quick, bold way.
example: The new manager cut the Gordian knot by merging the two teams.

fr.definition: Résoudre un problème complexe de façon radicale.

de.definition: Ein kompliziertes Problem kühn lösen.

es.definition: Resolver un problema complejo de forma audaz.

pt.definition: Resolver um problema complexo de forma ousada.

definition: Clear signs that something bad is going to happen.
example: When sales fell again, the staff saw the writing on the wall.

fr.definition: Signes clairs qu'un malheur approche.

de.definition: Klare Anzeichen für ein kommendes Unglück.

es.definition: Signos claros de que algo malo va a pasar.

pt.definition: Sinais claros de que algo mau vai acontecer.

definition: Something that seems good but brings serious problems.
example: Leading the failing project was a poisoned chalice.

fr.definition: Chose qui semble bonne mais pose de graves problèmes.

de.definition: Etwas scheinbar Gutes, das große Probleme bringt.

es.definition: Algo que parece bueno pero trae problemas.

pt.definition: Algo que parece bom mas traz problemas.

definition: Challenge someone to a contest or argument.
example: The rival firm threw down the gauntlet with lower prices.

fr.definition: Lancer un défi à quelqu'un.

de.definition: Jemanden herausfordern.

es.definition: Desafiar a alguien.

pt.definition: Desafiar alguém.

definition: Make someone else responsible for a problem.
example: Stop passing the buck and fix it yourself.

fr.definition: Rejeter la responsabilité sur un autre.

de.definition: Die Verantwortung auf andere abwälzen.

es.definition: Pasar la responsabilidad a otro.

pt.definition: Passar a responsabilidade a outro.

definition: I take final responsibility.
example: As director, the buck stops with me.

fr.definition: Je prends la responsabilité finale.

de.definition: Ich übernehme die letzte Verantwortung.

es.definition: Asumo la responsabilidad final.

pt.definition: Assumo a responsabilidade final.

definition: A holiday spent doing the same thing as your job.

fr.definition: Vacances passées à faire son propre métier.

de.definition: Freizeit mit derselben Tätigkeit wie im Beruf.

es.definition: Vacaciones haciendo lo mismo que en el trabajo.

pt.definition: Férias a fazer o mesmo que no trabalho.

word: damned if you do, damned if you don't
definition: Criticised whatever you decide.
example: Raise prices or cut quality: damned if you do, damned if you don't.

fr.definition: Critiqué quelle que soit la décision.

de.word: egal wie man es macht, es ist falsch
de.definition: Kritisiert, egal wie man entscheidet.

es.definition: Criticado decidas lo que decidas.

pt.word: preso por ter cão e preso por não ter
pt.definition: Criticado seja qual for a decisão.

definition: Spoil something by adding unnecessary decoration.

fr.definition: Gâcher une chose par des ajouts inutiles.

de.definition: Etwas durch unnötige Zusätze verderben.

es.definition: Estropear algo añadiendo adornos innecesarios.

pt.definition: Estragar algo com adornos desnecessários.

definition: Harmed by your own plan to harm others.
example: He tried to trick the auditors and was hoist with his own petard.

fr.definition: Victime de son propre piège.

de.definition: Durch den eigenen Plan geschädigt werden.

es.word: salirle el tiro por la culata
es.definition: Salir perjudicado por tu propio plan.

pt.definition: Ser prejudicado pelo próprio plano.

definition: Something with both good and bad parts.

fr.definition: Qui a du bon et du mauvais.

de.definition: Mit guten und schlechten Teilen.

es.definition: Algo con partes buenas y malas.

pt.definition: Algo com partes boas e más.

fr.definition: La plus grande partie.

de.definition: Der größte Teil.

pt.definition: A maior parte.

definition: Completely, including everything.

fr.definition: Complètement, tout compris.

de.definition: Vollständig, mit allem.

es.definition: Por completo, con todo incluido.

pt.definition: Por completo, com tudo incluído.

definition: Someone who stops others using what they cannot use themselves.
example: He won't use the car but won't lend it: a real dog in the manger.

de.definition: Wer anderen verweigert, was er selbst nicht nutzt.

pt.definition: Quem não usa algo nem deixa os outros usar.

fr.definition: Succès soudain qui ne dure pas.

pt.definition: Sucesso súbito que não dura.

fr.word: prendre le taureau par les cornes
fr.definition: Affronter un problème difficile avec courage.

de.word: den Stier bei den Hörnern packen

es.word: coger el toro por los cuernos
es.definition: Afrontar con valor un problema difícil.

pt.definition: Enfrentar com coragem um problema difícil.

definition: Nervously waiting for news.

fr.definition: Attendre des nouvelles avec anxiété.

de.definition: Nervös auf Nachrichten warten.

es.definition: Esperando noticias con nervios.

pt.definition: Ansioso à espera de notícias.

word: put the cart before the horse
definition: Do things in the wrong order.

fr.word: mettre la charrue avant les bœufs

de.definition: Dinge in der falschen Reihenfolge tun.

es.word: empezar la casa por el tejado
es.definition: Hacer las cosas en el orden equivocado.

pt.word: pôr o carro à frente dos bois

definition: Do something that is nearly illegal or dangerous.

fr.definition: Faire quelque chose de presque illégal ou risqué.

de.word: sich hart an der Grenze bewegen
de.definition: Etwas fast Illegales oder Riskantes tun.

es.definition: Hacer algo casi ilegal o peligroso.

pt.definition: Fazer algo quase ilegal ou perigoso.

definition: A deal where you give up your values for short-term gain.
example: Taking the sponsor's money felt like a Faustian bargain.

fr.definition: Accord où l'on sacrifie ses valeurs pour un gain immédiat.

de.definition: Ein Handel, bei dem man seine Werte verkauft.

pt.definition: Acordo em que se renuncia aos valores por um ganho.

definition: Completely unacceptable.
example: His comments about refugees were beyond the pale.

fr.definition: Complètement inacceptable.

de.definition: Völlig inakzeptabel.

es.definition: Totalmente inaceptable.

pt.definition: Totalmente inaceitável.

definition: You can only judge something by trying it.
example: The plan looks good, but the proof of the pudding is in the eating.

fr.definition: On ne peut juger qu'en essayant.

de.definition: Man kann nur durch Ausprobieren urteilen.

es.definition: Solo se puede juzgar algo probándolo.

pt.definition: Só se pode julgar algo experimentando.

definition: Fight enemies or problems that are imaginary.
example: Complaining about the new logo is just tilting at windmills.

fr.word: se battre contre des moulins à vent
fr.definition: Combattre des ennemis imaginaires.

de.definition: Gegen eingebildete Gegner kämpfen.

es.definition: Luchar contra enemigos imaginarios.

pt.definition: Lutar contra inimigos imaginários.

definition: A dangerous person who seems harmless.
example: The friendly investor turned out to be a wolf in sheep's clothing.

fr.definition: Personne dangereuse d'apparence inoffensive.

de.definition: Ein gefährlicher Mensch, der harmlos wirkt.

es.word: un lobo con piel de cordero

pt.word: um lobo com pele de cordeiro
pt.definition: Pessoa perigosa que parece inofensiva.

definition: Something expensive that is useless or hard to maintain.
example: The huge new stadium became a white elephant.

fr.definition: Chose coûteuse et inutile.

de.definition: Etwas Teures, das nutzlos oder lästig ist.

es.definition: Algo caro e inútil.

pt.definition: Algo caro e inútil.

definition: Be cut off from the practical problems of real life.
example: The experts seem to live in an ivory tower.

fr.definition: Être coupé des réalités.

de.definition: Von der Wirklichkeit abgeschnitten sein.

es.word: vivir en una torre de marfil
es.definition: Estar alejado de la realidad.

pt.definition: Estar afastado da realidade.

word: bite the hand that feeds you
definition: Harm someone who helps you.
example: Criticising your main client in public is biting the hand that feeds you.

fr.word: mordre la main qui vous nourrit
fr.definition: Nuire à celui qui vous aide.

de.word: die Hand beißen, die einen füttert
de.definition: Jemandem schaden, der einem hilft.

es.word: morder la mano que te da de comer

pt.word: morder a mão que nos alimenta

definition: Something everyone praises but that has no real value.
example: The expensive new strategy is the emperor's new clothes.

fr.definition: Chose louée par tous mais sans valeur réelle.

de.definition: Etwas von allen Gelobtes ohne echten Wert.

es.definition: Algo que todos alaban pero no vale nada.

pt.definition: Algo que todos elogiam mas não vale nada.

definition: Complete freedom to do what you want.
example: The designer was given carte blanche for the new office.

fr.definition: Totale liberté d'agir.

de.definition: Völlige Freiheit, zu tun, was man will.

es.definition: Libertad total para actuar.

pt.definition: Total liberdade para agir.

fr.definition: S'occuper de futilités pendant une crise.

de.definition: Sich mit Unwichtigem befassen, während es brennt.

es.word: tocar la lira mientras arde Roma

pt.definition: Ocupar-se de coisas fúteis durante uma crise.

definition: Offer something valuable to people who cannot appreciate it.
example: Explaining fine wine to him is casting pearls before swine.

fr.word: donner de la confiture aux cochons
fr.definition: Offrir quelque chose de précieux à qui ne l'apprécie pas.

de.definition: Wertvolles an Menschen geben, die es nicht schätzen.

es.definition: Ofrecer algo valioso a quien no lo aprecia.

pt.definition: Oferecer algo valioso a quem não o aprecia.

definition: An idea or custom that people are afraid to criticise.
example: The annual bonus is a sacred cow nobody dares to question.

fr.definition: Idée ou coutume qu'on n'ose pas critiquer.

de.definition: Eine Idee, die niemand zu kritisieren wagt.

es.definition: Idea o costumbre que nadie se atreve a criticar.

pt.definition: Ideia ou costume que ninguém ousa criticar.

definition: A win that brings no real benefit or satisfaction.
example: They won the court case, but the legal costs made it a hollow victory.

fr.definition: Victoire sans réel bénéfice.

de.definition: Ein Sieg ohne echten Nutzen.

es.definition: Victoria que no aporta un beneficio real.

pt.definition: Vitória sem benefício real.
